connector.name: 3D AI Agent Avatar
connector.registryDescription: 3D AI Agent Avatar - render any GLB, give it a Solana wallet, a voice, and pump.fun powers.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package avatar-agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com — bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production traffic.

env.name: ETH_RPC_URL
env.description: Ethereum mainnet RPC for ENS resolution. Optional — falls back to ethers' default public providers.

env.name: HELIUS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Helius API key — enables exact supply + DAS data in pump_snapshot.

env.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
env.description: NVIDIA NIM key (nvapi-…) — leads the speak tool's TTS provider chain with the free Magpie TTS lane.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI TTS — the speak tool's paid backstop when the free NVIDIA lane is unavailable.

env.name: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Required for the generate_avatar tool (Replicate text/image-to-3D).

env.name: REPLICATE_TEXT_TO_AVATAR_MODEL
env.description: Replicate version hash pinned for text-to-3D — recommended: latest tencent/hunyuan-3d-3.1.

env.name: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Optional default base58 Solana secret for wallet_send / pump_buy. Per-call secret args override this. Treat like cash.

env.name: THREE_MINT
env.description: Optional pump.fun mint address for $three so tools accept target="three" as shorthand.

env.name: MAX_SOL_PER_TX
env.description: Per-transaction spend cap in SOL for the execution tools (wallet_send, pump_buy, pump_launch, pump_collect_fees).

env.name: REQUIRE_CONFIRM
env.description: When on (default), execution tools refuse until re-issued with confirm:true. Set 0/false to disable the gate.
